name: FAQ, quick answers
description: A grid of yes, no and coming soon answers in large type, each with a short line of detail.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Straight answers to what people ask in the first five minutes of a demo.

default.question: Is there a free trial?
default.detail: 14 days with every feature and 10 recorded hours.

default.question: Do I need a credit card to start?
default.detail: Add one only when you pick a plan.

default.question: Does it work with Zoom?
default.detail: And with Google Meet and Microsoft Teams.

default.question: Will it run on-premises?
default.detail: We host in Canada, the US or the EU.

default.question: Is there a Figma plugin?
default.detail: In beta with 40 teams, shipping in November.

default.question: Can I cancel any time?
default.detail: Monthly plans stop at the end of the period.
